title: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
field: Engineering, Science, Technology, Medicine, Economics, Agriculture, Islamic Studies
description: The Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS) is an initiative by the Malaysian government to attract the best minds from around the world to pursue postgraduate studies in Malaysia. It aims to support Malaysia's aspiration to become a global academic hub.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance RM 1,500, book allowance, return economy airfare, medical insurance, visa fee waiver
eligibility: Applicants from eligible countries with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 for Master and 3.5 for PhD; maximum age 40 for Master and 45 for PhD

title: Thailand International Postgraduate Programme (TIPP)
field: Agriculture, Public Health, Climate Change, Sustainable Development, Food Security, Economics, Environmental Management
description: The Thailand International Postgraduate Programme (TIPP) provides scholarships for professionals from developing countries to pursue postgraduate studies in Thailand, focusing on sustainable development and South-South cooperation.
amount: Full tuition fee, monthly living allowance, accommodation support, round-trip economy airfare, health and accident insurance, orientation program
eligibility: Officials and professionals from developing countries in Asia, Africa, Latin America, and the Pacific; nominated by their government

title: Darmasiswa Indonesian Scholarship
field: Indonesian Language, Arts, Music, Dance, Culinary, Indonesian Culture, Traditional Crafts
description: Darmasiswa is a non-degree scholarship program offered by the Indonesian government to international students to study Indonesian language, arts, and culture at Indonesian universities. It promotes cultural exchange and mutual understanding.
amount: Monthly living allowance IDR 2,500,000, tuition fee waiver, accommodation assistance, cultural immersion programs, opportunity to learn Bahasa Indonesia
eligibility: International students aged 18-35 from countries with diplomatic relations with Indonesia; high school graduate
source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology of Indonesia

title: Kemitraan Negara Berkembang (KNB) Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Agriculture, Economics, Education, Social Sciences, Health Sciences
description: The KNB Scholarship is a prestigious Indonesian government scholarship for students from developing countries to pursue undergraduate, master's, and doctoral degrees at top Indonesian universities.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance, round-trip international airfare, health insurance, settlement allowance, Indonesian language training
eligibility: Citizens of developing countries; maximum age 25 for Bachelor, 35 for Master, 40 for PhD; good academic record with minimum CGPA 2.75
source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology of Indonesia

title: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
field: Agriculture, Engineering, Public Health, Information Technology, Business Administration, Environmental Science, Development Studies
description: The TaiwanICDF Scholarship supports students from partner developing countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan. The program emphasizes development-oriented studies that contribute to the recipient's home country development.
amount: Full tuition and credit fees, monthly living allowance NTD 18,000, round-trip economy airfare, textbook allowance, health and accident insurance, housing subsidy
eligibility: Applicants from eligible developing countries; meet academic requirements of partner university; commitment to return to home country

title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Management, Applied Sciences
description: The NYCU International Student Scholarship supports outstanding international graduate students at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, one of Taiwan's top research universities specializing in engineering and technology.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend NTD 8,000-15,000, research assistantship opportunities, state-of-the-art research facilities
university: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
eligibility: International students with bachelor's or master's degree; excellent academic record; research potential; minimum CGPA 3.0
source: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

title: Vietnam Government Scholarship (VGS)
field: Vietnamese Studies, Engineering, Agriculture, Medicine, Economics, Information Technology, Tourism
description: The Vietnam Government Scholarship provides opportunities for international students to study at Vietnamese higher education institutions under bilateral cooperation agreements. It promotes educational exchange and friendship between Vietnam and other nations.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance, accommodation provided, health insurance, one round-trip airfare, Vietnamese language training included
eligibility: Citizens of countries with bilateral cooperation agreements with Vietnam; excellent health; commitment to return after studies
source: Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam

title: Vingroup Young Talent Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Health Sciences, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science
description: The Vingroup Young Talent Scholarship supports outstanding individuals to study at VinUniversity and partner institutions worldwide, focusing on science, technology, and innovation fields.
amount: 100% tuition fee coverage, monthly living stipend, research and innovation funding, international exchange opportunities, mentorship from industry leaders, career placement support
eligibility: Vietnamese and international students with exceptional academic achievement and leadership potential; minimum CGPA 3.5

title: PolyU International Postgraduate Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Design, Textiles, Hospitality, Health Sciences, Applied Science
description: PolyU's International Postgraduate Scholarship attracts top-tier international students to pursue research and taught postgraduate programs in one of Asia's leading applied research universities.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend HKD 18,100-25,000, annual conference travel allowance, research support grant, halls of residence placement
eligibility: International students with excellent academic credentials; research experience preferred for PhD; minimum CGPA 3.5

title: University of Macau Postgraduate Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business Administration, Law, Social Sciences, Chinese Medicine, Education
description: The University of Macau Postgraduate Scholarship supports high-caliber international students to pursue advanced degrees in Macau's premier university, blending Chinese and Western educational traditions.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend MOP 8,000-20,000, research assistantship, annual travel grant, on-campus accommodation priority
eligibility: International students with strong academic background; research potential for PhD applicants; minimum CGPA 3.0

title: Macao Polytechnic University International Scholarship
field: Computer Science, Translation, Gaming Management, Public Administration, Arts, Nursing, Social Work
description: Macao Polytechnic University offers scholarships to international students from Portuguese-speaking and Belt and Road countries, promoting educational collaboration between Macau and partner nations.
amount: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance, accommodation subsidy, cultural integration programs, internship opportunities in Macau
eligibility: International students from Portuguese-speaking countries and Belt and Road Initiative countries; strong academic record

title: Bolashak International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Medicine, Information Technology, Economics, Public Administration, Education, Natural Sciences
description: The Bolashak International Scholarship is Kazakhstan's premier government-funded scholarship program, enabling talented individuals to study at leading universities worldwide and contribute to Kazakhstan's development.
amount: Full tuition fee coverage, monthly living stipend, international travel costs, accommodation allowance, health insurance, book and study materials allowance
eligibility: Citizens of Kazakhstan and select international students; high academic achievement; commitment to return and work in Kazakhstan; minimum CGPA 3.0

title: El-Yurt Umidi Foundation Scholarship
field: Economics, Engineering, IT, Medicine, Education, Law, Public Administration
description: The El-Yurt Umidi Foundation provides scholarships for talented Uzbek students to pursue postgraduate education at top universities abroad, supporting Uzbekistan's human capital development strategy.
amount: Full tuition fee payment, monthly stipend for living costs, round-trip airfare, accommodation support, health insurance, visa processing assistance
eligibility: Citizens of Uzbekistan; bachelor's degree for Master applicants; must pass competitive selection including exams and interviews

title: Study in India Scholarship
field: Engineering, Information Technology, Management, Science, Arts, Commerce, Pharmacy
description: The Study in India program offers scholarships to international students to pursue higher education in Indian institutions. It aims to make India a preferred education destination for students from developing countries.
amount: Tuition fee waiver, monthly sustenance allowance, hostel accommodation, access to Indian higher education institutions, cultural exchange opportunities
eligibility: Students from SAARC, African, and other developing countries; meet academic eligibility criteria of chosen institution
source: Ministry of Education, Government of India

title: ICCR Scholarship for International Students
field: Arts, Humanities, Engineering, Sciences, Commerce, Social Sciences, Indian Culture
description: The ICCR Scholarship Program is administered by the Indian Council for Cultural Relations to promote cultural exchange and educational cooperation between India and other nations. It covers a wide range of academic disciplines.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance, accommodation in hostel, thesis/dissertation expenses, return airfare for eligible countries
eligibility: Students from select foreign countries; nominated through Indian Missions abroad; age and academic criteria as per course

title: HEC Pakistan Overseas Scholarship for International Students
field: Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Business, Computer Science, Social Sciences, Islamic Studies
description: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan offers scholarships for international students from friendly countries to study at Pakistani universities, promoting educational diplomacy and regional cooperation.
amount: Full tuition fee, monthly stipend, accommodation, book allowance, medical insurance
eligibility: Students from friendly countries and developing nations; meet academic and age criteria specified by HEC; minimum CGPA 2.5

title: Nepal Government Scholarship for International Students
field: Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Forestry, Development Studies, Buddhist Studies, Himalayan Studies
description: The Nepal Government Scholarship supports international students, particularly from SAARC and developing countries, to pursue higher education at Nepali universities, promoting academic exchange and regional cooperation.
amount: Tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance, hostel accommodation, medical insurance, field study opportunities
university: Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu University, and other Nepali Universities
eligibility: Students from SAARC countries and developing nations; meet academic eligibility for chosen program; medical fitness certificate required
source: Ministry of Education, Science and Technology of Nepal

title: Sri Lanka Presidential Scholarship for Foreign Students
field: Agriculture, Engineering, Medicine, Information Technology, Buddhist Studies, Management, Fisheries
description: The Presidential Scholarship Program of Sri Lanka provides opportunities for international students from developing countries to pursue higher education at Sri Lankan universities, fostering international goodwill and cooperation.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, monthly living allowance LKR 30,000, hostel accommodation, medical cover, return airfare
eligibility: Citizens of eligible developing countries; meet university admission requirements; under 35 years of age for Master and 40 for PhD
source: Ministry of Higher Education of Sri Lanka

title: UAE Golden Visa Scholarship for Outstanding Students
field: Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Space Science, Renewable Energy, Business, Medicine, Cybersecurity
description: The UAE offers scholarships tied to the Golden Visa program for outstanding international students to study at UAE universities, supporting the country's vision to become a global hub for innovation and education.
amount: Full tuition fee coverage, monthly stipend AED 5,000-10,000, accommodation, health insurance, long-term residency visa, internship opportunities
university: UAE University, Khalifa University, University of Sharjah, American University of Sharjah
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic records (top 10%); demonstrated innovation and leadership potential; nominated by institution
